# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 18 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-17 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level17_widening.rs) to level 18 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-17
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-18 "Special" column reads "Mass
# suggestion, versatile performance" — verified independently against two
# primary sources (a raw HTML parse of d20pfsrd.com's own class table,
# bypassing AI-summarization, and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror
# via ClassDisplay.aspx, both byte-for-byte identical: "+13/+8/+3 | +6 |
# +11 | +11 | Mass suggestion, Versatile performance"), with neighboring
# levels 16 ("—", blank), 17 ("Inspire courage +4, lore master 3/day"), and
# 19 ("Inspire competence +6") fetched too to rule out misattribution. Base
# attack bonus genuinely rises to 13 (18*3/4), both good saves (Reflex,
# Will) genuinely rise to 11 (18/2+2), poor Fortitude genuinely rises to 6
# (18/3), Bardic Knowledge genuinely rises to 9 (max(18/2,1)), the
# Fascinate DC genuinely rises to 21 (10+18/2+CHA), the Fascinate
# affected-creature count stays 6 (1+(18-1)/3, an integer-division
# coincidence with level 17), and Frightening Tune's DC (the same formula
# shape) likewise genuinely rises to 21. Inspire Courage stays +4 (next
# tier out of scope), Inspire Competence stays +5 (next tier at level 19,
# out of scope), and Lore Master stays 3/day (next tier out of scope).
# Inspire Heroics' flat save-bonus (+4) and AC-bonus (+4) magnitudes stay
# unchanged, but its base target count genuinely rises from 1 to 2 — the
# PF1 Core Rulebook's own "for every three bard levels the character
# attains beyond 15th, he can inspire heroics in one additional creature"
# scaling lands exactly at bard level 18, verified against the rule text
# directly rather than assumed, mirroring the Fascinate
# affected-creature-count idiom's own tiered-threshold shape.
#
# Neither level-18 Special-column entry is grounded as a new record. "Mass
# suggestion" is verified against its own PF1 rule text ("This ability
# functions just like suggestion, but allows a bard of 18th level or
# higher to make a suggestion simultaneously to any number of creatures
# that he has already fascinated") to be a strict widening of the
# already-declined 6th-level Suggestion spell-like ability (itself left
# named-but-unproven at level 6 because it requires a fascinated-target
# prerequisite and the "suggestion" spell's own effect-resolution engine,
# neither of which exists in this codebase) — Mass Suggestion inherits the
# identical blocker and adds a multi-target dimension on top of it, so it
# is deliberately left named-but-unproven, with no record fabricated for
# it, exactly mirroring the level-6 Suggestion precedent. "Versatile
# performance" is a REPEAT of the Bard's own 2nd-level grant (also seen at
# levels 6, 10, and 14): it was already deliberately left named-but-unproven
# at level 2 (requires a choice-gated skill-substitution engine that does
# not exist in this codebase), so this cycle adds no new record for its
# level-18 reappearance either.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion or Mass Suggestion execution, no
# Dirge of Doom execution, no Inspire Greatness execution, no
# untrained-skill-use execution for Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master
# take-10/take-20 execution against any actual Knowledge check, no
# Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal execution, no Frightening
# Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire Heroics
# targeting/save/AC-application execution, and no spontaneous known-spell /
# slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level18
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:18
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
